investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Veleron Journeys (travel booking); Platform: Microsoft Azure westeurope (zones westeurope-1/westeurope-2/westeurope-3); network range 10.125.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster velero-prod-westeu (AKS); Database: travellers-db-01 holds travellers records; Automation: data-retention workflows scheduled by Argo Workflows and executed under service accounts (runs recorded with RUN- identifiers); Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
